pages.text: $(bold)Horizon of Oscillating Veils$(): a single boat adrift on ten thousand waves.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x45 curse power per second. The instant it expands, the interior $(blue)floods with seawater$(); the caster $(bold)cannot drown$() (permanent Water Breathing), and allied targets - the caster's shikigami, cursed spirits, guardians and the like - gain Water Breathing as well. Every other creature inside follows the normal breathing rules and will drown in the water.

$(bold)Drowned Legion$(): while the domain is active, it maintains a swarm of drowned owned by the caster (6 + radius/2 of them, up to 24). The drowned $(red)actively hunt every target inside that is not on the caster's side$(): they swim up and strike in melee, and are replenished automatically as they die; about 1 in 5 wields a trident (higher melee damage).$(br2)$(bold)Ending$(): when the domain closes (manually, out of curse power, destroyed, or upon death/logout), everything reverts to normal - the water turns back into air and every drowned disperses.
